# Nexbeck

> Nexbeck is a specialised web design and development agency that helps Australian electricians and trade contractors build trust, win local enquiries, and own their online presence.

Nexbeck provides custom high-performance website design, website redesigns, and free website performance audits with transparent fixed pricing in AUD and 100% client code ownership.

## Company Overview

- Company: Nexbeck
- Website: https://nexbeck.com
- Industry: Web Design and Development
- Target Market: Australian electricians, electrical contractors, air conditioning and trade businesses
- Service Area: Australia-wide (NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT, NT)

## Services

- Custom Electrician Website Design: High-converting, mobile-optimised websites hand-coded for speed, click-to-call usability, and local search visibility.
- Website Redesign: Transforming outdated, slow, or template-bloated trade websites into modern, high-converting platforms.
- Free Website Audit: 48-hour plain-English review of mobile speed, local SEO schema, and enquiry bottlenecks with zero sales pressure.

## Pricing

- Essential Package: $890 AUD (Under $1,000 AUD) - 3 pages, mobile-first design, review integration, 1 revision round, 7-day turnaround.
- Professional Package: $1,390 AUD ($1,000–$1,500 AUD) - 5 pages, suburban landing pages, before/after showcase, 3 revision rounds, 7–14 day turnaround.
- Premium Package: $1,990 AUD ($1,500–$2,300 AUD) - Authority platform, interactive quote calculator, emergency callout features, 5 revision rounds, 14–18 day turnaround.

For complete pricing details, inclusions and conditions, see:
https://nexbeck.com/services
